note: Checks against two GURS services, read in the browser on 12 November 2026. Municipality and settlement: register of spatial units (wfs-si-gurs-rpe, collections OBCINE and NASELJA) at the stored point, and for tunnels also at both ends of the drawn line. Road and railway: centre lines of the cadastre of public infrastructure (wfs-si-gurs-kgi, LINIJE_CESTE_G and LINIJE_ZELEZNICE_G) within 120 m (road) or 300 m (railway) of the point. Distances are from the stored point and from the vertices of the drawn line that fall in that box. The infrastructure cadastre gives no names and no object type, so it confirms where a road or railway runs, not which bridge or tunnel it is. This file adds the raw attribute rows without the geometries.
